evidence.title: GitHub - avalynndev/anonypost: A website where you can enter anonymous posts for others to read

name: Anonypost
summary: Anonymous posting site: write posts and replies without an account, built on the T3 stack.
description: An open-source anonymous posting platform where posts and replies need no account. Built with Next.js, tRPC and shadcn/ui; clone the repo, add an environment file and deploy — the README covers a one-click deploy to Vercel.
contains: anonymous posts and replies, no sign-up needed
built with Next.js, tRPC and shadcn/ui
installation and environment setup in the README
